## House style (required)

Author and reviewer: every box must be true before merge.

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] No `any`, no non-null `!`, no `interface`
- [ ] No inline `style={{...}}`; CSS is `styles.module.css`
- [ ] Named exports; relative imports (no `@/`)
- [ ] Routes from `paths.ts`; lists/URLs in `consts.ts`
- [ ] User-facing copy (including `alt` / `aria-label`) in `en` / `hy` / `ru` with camelCase keys
- [ ] Cursor review against `.cursor/rules/` (skill: `.cursor/skills/code-review/`)
